m: नि-√ बाध् Ā. -बाधते, to press down or together, confine, obstruct, oppress, RV.
नि-बाध See अ-निबाध.
नि-बाढ or नि-बा|अ, mfn. (√ बंह्) forced down, thrown into (loc.), RV. i, 106, 6.

a: निबंध् — {c9c} P. 1 To bind, tie, fasten, chain, fetter; आत्मवंतं न कर्माणि निबध्नंति धनंजय Bg. 4. 41; 9. 9; 14. 7; 18. 17; Ms. 6. 14; Ku. 5. 10. --2 To fix upon, rivet; त्वयि निबद्धरतेः V. 4. 29, Bh. 3. 87. --3 To join, unite, connect; R. 13. 15. --4 To form, build, construct, arrange; हेमनिबद्धं चक्रं, पाषाणचयबद्धः कूपः &c. --5 To write, compose, मया निबद्धेयमतिद्वयी कथा K. 5. --6 To restrain, obstruct. --7 To fix upon, impose. --8 To appoint. --9 To place, locate.

निबंधः — 1 Binding, tying, fastening. --2 Attachment, intentness; Bg. 16. 5. --3 Composing, writing down. --4 A literary composition or treatise, work; प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबंधविन्यासवैदग्ध्यनिधिर्निबंधं चक्रे Vās. --5 A compendium. --6 Restraint, obstruction, confinement. --7 Suppression of urine. --8 A bond, fetter. --9 A grant of property, an assignment of cattle, money &c. for support; भूर्या पितामहोपात्ता निबंधो द्रव्यमेव वा Y. 2. 121. --10 Fixed property. --11 Foundation, origin. --12 Cause, reason. --धं Song, singing.

निबंधनं — 1 The act of fastening, binding together. --2 Constructing, building. --3 Restraining, checking confining. --4 A bond, fetter. --5 A tie, band, support, stay; आशानिबंधनं जाता जीवलोकस्य U. 3; यस्त्वमिव मामकीनस्य मनसो द्वितीयं निबंधनं Māl. 3. --6 Dependence, connection; ते त्वदाशानिबंधनाः M. 4. 14; परस्परनिबंधनः Pt. 1. 79 ‘inter-dependent.’ --7 Cause, origin, ground, motive, basis, foundation; वाक्प्रतिष्ठानिबंधनानि देहिनां व्यवहारतंत्राणि Māl. 4 ‘based on’ &c.; प्रत्याशा˚ 3; अनिबंधन causeless, accidental; U. 5, 7. --8 Abode, seat, receptacle; Māl. 2. 6. --9 Composing, arrangement; Ku. 7. 90 (रचना). --10 A literary composition or work, a treatise. --11 A grant (of land), an assignment; सद्वृत्तिः सन्निबंधना Śi. 2. 112 (where निबंधन means ‘a treatise’ also). --12 The peg of a lute. --13 (In gram.) Syntax. --14 A commentary.
निबंधिन् — a. 1 Binding, fastening, confining. --2 Connected with. --3 Causing, being the origin of, producing.
निबंद्धृ — m. 1 A writer, author. --2 A commentator. --3 A binder.

shut up, closed, obstructed, Kathās.

composed, written down, R.; Kālid. &c.
used, employed as a word, Sāh.
called as a witness (अ-न्˚, Mn. viii, 76)
confined costive, W.
committed, intrusted, MW.
नि-˚बद्ध m. (in music) a partic. instrument.
a: निबद्ध — p. p. 1 Bound, tied, fettered, stopped, closed &c. --2 Connected with, relating to. --3 Formed of --4 Set or inlaid with. --5 Called as a witness. --6 Restricted, checked. --7 Composed, written. --8 Covered with, enveloped. --9 Furnished with.

m: नि-˚बद्धव्य (!) mfn. necessarily connected with (instr.), Sāh.
निबल m. or n. a partic. number, Buddh.

नि-√ बन्ध् P. -बध्नाति, to bind on, tie, fasten to (loc.), AV.; Kauś.; MBh. &c.; to enchain, fetter (lit. and fig.), Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.; to contract, unite, join, close, obstruct, Kāv.; Kathās.; to compose, draw up, write down, Mn.; Var.; R. &c.; to catch, win, acquire, MBh.; Pañc.; to hold fast, restrain, check, MBh.; Ragh.; to put or fix upon (foot, eye &c. i.e. undertake, begin, with loc.), Hariv.; Kāv.; Pañc.; to fix, place, locate, Rājat.; to show, exhibit, Sāh. : Pass. -बध्यते, to be bound &c., Mn.; MBh. &c.

m: नि-˚बर्हि˚तांहस् mfn. destroying sin, Śiś. i, 29.

नि-√ बृह् (वृह्) P. -बृहति (aor. -बर्हीत्), to throw down, overthrow, crush, destroy, RV. : Caus. -बर्हयति id., ib.; MBh. &c.
निबिडी-√ कृ to make tight or firm, bend (a bow), Vcar.

नि-बिड mf(आ)n. or नि-विड (prob. fr. बिड = बिल, a hole; cf. नि-खिल) without spaces or interstices, close, compact, thick, dense, firm, MBh.; Kāv. &c. full of abounding in (instr. or comp.), Hariv.; Śak. vii, 11 (v.l. for नि-चित)
low, Kād.
crooked-nosed, Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś.
नि-बिड m. N. of a mountain, MBh. vi, 460
नि-बिड n. crooked-nosedness, Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś.
a: निबिड — a. 1 Dense, thick. --2 Hard, difficult; Ku. 3. 59. See निविड.

m: निबिडय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make tight, embrace firmly, Bālar. ii, 62.
निबि˚डित mfn. made tight, become thick or heavy, Mālatīm.
pressed close to, Bālar. v, 19.
निबिरीश mfn. = नि-बिड, Kāv. (-नि-तम्ब, Śiś. vii, 20), Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś. (W. निविडीष).
नि-˚बोद्धव्य mfn. to be learnt
to be regarded or considered as (with nomin.), Var.
नि-˚बोद्धृ mfn. knowing, wise, Gal.

नि-√ बुध् P. -बोधति (aor. -बोधिषत्, RV.), to learn or hear anything (acc.) from any one (gen., rarely सकाशात्), to attend or listen to (esp. Impv. निबोध, ˚धत; rarely ˚धस्व, ˚धध्वम्); to know, understand, consider as (often with double acc.), RV.; AV.; Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -बोधयति, to cause to know or learn, to inform, tell, BhP.
a: निबुध् — {c1c} P. 1 To know, understand, learn; निबोध साधो तव चेत्कुतूहलं Ku. 5. 52; 3. 14; Ms. 1. 68; Y. 1. 2. --2 To regard or consider as, deem. --3 To listen or attend to. --Caus. To explain, inform, acquaint.

m: नि-बुसी-कृत mfn. freed from chaff, husked, Kuval. (cf. निर्-ब्˚).
